title: Family invite (ward -> family-gateway)
description: Pushed outbound when a nurse creates an invite after the patient (or legal representative) has given recorded consent (safety invariant 4). The relative redeems it with the QR code AND a one-time code. Only a hash of the one-time code leaves the ward.

relativeLabel.description: How the relative is shown to staff, e.g. 'Daughter'. Synthetic in the demo.

allowedKinds.description: Subset of family-update kinds the patient consented to share with this relative.

expiresAt.description: Hard upper bound. Discharge or transfer revokes earlier via family-revocation.

codeHash.description: Salted hash of the one-time code: 'scrypt$N$r$p$<salt base64url>$<hash base64url>' (32-byte hash). Reference implementation: server/borj_server/family.py hash_code / verify_code.
